analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Yesterday and Intraday Today (Nov 4th/5th)
key_insights: Nov 4: broader markets rose, but a rotation out of semis into software drove a sharp sell-off in US momentum.
Nov 4: systematic long/short funds ended slightly up as EM Asia gains offset US losses. Global fundamental funds rose on the broad market rally. Multi-strategy funds were modestly lower.
Nov 5 (about 10:30 EST): US markets are selling off and global momentum is down. Fundamental funds are down, with US-focused funds hit harder.
Nov 5 intraday: TMT is severely down. Systematic funds are positive. Multi-strategy funds are down significantly on their equity exposure.
risk_factors: US momentum factor is vulnerable to sector rotations such as semis to software.
Multi-strategy funds are exposed to equity drawdowns, as shown by the intraday Nov 5 decline.
vol_and_positioning: Nov 4: semis-to-software rotation drove a sharp US momentum factor sell-off while broader indices rose.
Nov 5 about 10:30 EST: global momentum is down and TMT is severely down in hedge fund performance.
Systematic L/S: slightly up on Nov 4 and positive intraday Nov 5.
Global fundamental L/S: up on Nov 4, down intraday Nov 5, with US-focused funds hit harder.
Multi-strategy funds: modestly lower on Nov 4 and significantly down intraday Nov 5 on their equity exposure.
contextual_mentions: Semis-to-software rotation driving US momentum sell-off
Hedge fund TMT exposure severely down intraday Nov 5
Multi-strategy funds hit by equity exposure losses
US-focused fundamental funds underperforming global peers intraday
